text: Cooks can flip the whole page to a warm dark theme at night, and it remembers their choice next time.
acceptance: Tap the moon button — the whole page turns dark.
Tap it again — it goes back to light.
Close the app and reopen it — it remembers your last choice.

text: People can find a recipe by the ingredients it uses, not just its name.
acceptance: Type 'tomato' — the recipes that use tomato show up.
Type an ingredient no recipe uses — you get a friendly empty state.
